question: What are the titles and IDs of research papers that include a benchmark for the DDI extraction 2013 corpus dataset?
sparql:
PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paper_lbl
WHERE {
  ?dataset        a                orkgc:Dataset;
                  rdfs:label       ?dataset_lbl.
  FILTER (str(?dataset_lbl) = "DDI extraction 2013 corpus")
  ?benchmark      orkgp:HAS_DATASET       ?dataset.
  ?cont          orkgp:HAS_BENCHMARK      ?benchmark.
  ?paper         orkgp:P31                ?cont;
                 rdfs:label               ?paper_lbl.
}

List the metrics that are used to evaluate models on the Pubmed benchmark dataset?
What is the average energy generation of all energy sources considered?
sparql:
PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (AVG(?elec_gen_value) AS ?average_elec_gen_value)
WHERE {
  orkgr:R153801 orkgp:compareContribution ?contrib.
  ?contrib orkgp:P43135 ?energy_sources.
  ?energy_sources rdfs:label ?energy_sources_labels;
                  orkgp:P43134 ?electricity_generation.
  FILTER(REGEX(?energy_sources_labels, "all sources"))
  ?electricity_generation orkgp:HAS_VALUE ?value.
  BIND(xsd:float(?value) AS ?elec_gen_value)
}

What is the top benchmark result (metric and value) over the dataset ANLI test?
Give me a list of research papers along with their titles and IDs, that have performed benchmarks on the AESLC dataset?
sparql:
PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paper_lbl
WHERE {
  ?dataset        a                orkgc:Dataset;
                  rdfs:label       ?dataset_lbl.
  FILTER (str(?dataset_lbl) = "AESLC")
  ?benchmark      orkgp:HAS_DATASET       ?dataset.
  ?cont          orkgp:HAS_BENCHMARK      ?benchmark.
  ?paper         orkgp:P31                ?cont;
                 rdfs:label               ?paper_lbl.
}

question: What is the scope of "Decentralised Authoring, Annotations and Notifications for a Read-Write Web with Dokieli"?

WHERE {
  orkgr:R8364 orkgp:compareContribution ?cont.
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?cont;
         rdfs:label ?title.
  ?cont orkgp:P7046 ?sys.
  ?sys orkgp:P7047 ?scope.
  FILTER(REGEX(STR(?title), "Decentralised Authoring, Annotations and Notifications for a Read-Write Web with dokieli"))
}

What is the minimum and maximum installed capacity for each energy source considered?
sparql:
PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?energy_sources_labels (MIN(?installed_cap_value) AS ?min_installed_cap_value) (MAX(?installed_cap_value) AS ?max_installed_cap_value)
WHERE {
  orkgr:R153801 orkgp:compareContribution ?contrib.
  ?contrib orkgp:P43135 ?energy_sources.
  ?energy_sources rdfs:label ?energy_sources_labels;
                  orkgp:P43133 ?installed_capacity.
  ?installed_capacity orkgp:HAS_VALUE ?value.
  BIND(xsd:float(?value) AS ?installed_cap_value)
}

question: What evaluation metrics are commonly used when benchmarking models on the DDI dataset?
What are the metrics of evaluation over the NYT-single dataset?
What is the top benchmark score and its metric on the WebNLG dataset?
What is the average installed capacity for each energy source considered in 5 year intervals?
sparql:
PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?rangeId ?energy_sources_labels (AVG(?installed_cap_value AS ?avg_installed_cap_value))
WHERE {
  orkgr:R153801 orkgp:compareContribution ?contrib.
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contrib;
         orkgp:P29 ?year.
  BIND(xsd:int(?year) AS ?y).
  VALUES(?rangeId ?min ?max) {
    ("2001-2005" 2001 2005)
    ("2006-2010" 2006 2010)
    ("2011-2015" 2011 2015)
    ("2016-2020" 2016 2020)
  }
  FILTER(?min <= ?y && ?y <= ?max).
  ?contrib orkgp:P43135 ?energy_sources.
  ?energy_sources rdfs:label ?energy_sources_labels;
                  orkgp:P43133 ?installed_capacity.
  ?installed_capacity orkgp:HAS_VALUE ?value.
  BIND(xsd:float(?value) AS ?installed_cap_value).
}
ORDER BY ASC(?rangeId)

question: Does ViCoMap support aggregation?

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>

PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?has_aggregation_support
WHERE {
  ?application rdfs:label "ViCoMap"^^xsd:string;
               orkgp:P5038 ?has_aggregation_support_.

  )
}

question: What is the average installed capacity of all energy sources considered?
sparql:
PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (AVG(?installed_cap_value) AS ?average_installed_cap_value)
WHERE {
  orkgr:R153801 orkgp:compareContribution ?contrib.
  ?contrib orkgp:P43135 ?energy_sources.
  ?energy_sources rdfs:label ?energy_sources_labels;
                  orkgp:P43133 ?installed_capacity.
  FILTER(REGEX(?energy_sources_labels, "all sources"))
  ?installed_capacity orkgp:HAS_VALUE ?value.
  BIND(xsd:float(?value) AS ?installed_cap_value)
}

}

PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>

PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?code
WHERE {
  ?model    a            orkgc:Model;
            rdfs:label    ?model_lbl.
  FILTER (str(?model_lbl) = "BiLSTM-CRF")
  ?benchmark      orkgp:HAS_DATASET        ?dataset.
  ?cont           orkgp:HAS_BENCHMARK      ?benchmark.
  ?cont           orkgp:HAS_MODEL          ?model;
                  orkgp:HAS_SOURCE_CODE    ?code.
}

question: Can you list the metrics used to evaluate models on the TDMSci dataset?
Which model has achieved the highest F1 score score on the BUCC French-to-English benchmark dataset?
What is the highest benchmark result achieved on the WMT2014 English-French dataset, including the metric and its value?
Who is the author with the largest number of papers about semantic representation in music research problem?
sparql:
PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?author
WHERE {
  ?papers rdf:type orkgc:Paper.
  ?papers orkgp:P31 ?contrib.
  ?contrib orkgp:P32 ?research_problems.
  ?research_problems rdfs:label ?research_problems_labels.
  FILTER(REGEX(?research_problems_labels, "semantic representation in music", "i"))
  ?papers orkgp:P27 ?authors.
  OPTIONAL {
    ?authors rdfs:label ?authors_labels
  }
  BIND(IF(BOUND(?authors_labels), ?authors_labels, ?authors) AS ?author)
}
ORDER BY DESC(COUNT(?author))
LIMIT 1

question: Does OWLMAP imply integrity constraints?

}

question: What is the precision and recall of SemGraphQA?
sparql:
PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?precision ?recall
WHERE {
  orkgr:R6898 orkgp:compareContribution ?cont. 
  ?cont orkgp:P34 ?eval.
  ?eval rdfs:label ?eval_labels.
  FILTER(REGEX(?eval_labels, "SemGraphQA"))
  ?eval orkgp:P3004 ?precision;
        orkgp:P5015 ?recall.
}

question: What is the total number of patients in the studies?
sparql:
PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT SUM(?number_of_patients)
WHERE {
  orkgr:R33008 orkgp:compareContribution ?contrib.
  ?contrib orkgp:P15585 ?patients.
  BIND(xsd:integer(?patients) AS ?number_of_patients)
}
